description_en: Queries the distributed transaction whitelists of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS SQL Server实例的分布式事务白名单信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-dtc-security-ip-hosts-for-sql-server --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDTCSecurityIpHostsForSQLServer

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

IpHostPairNum.description_en: The number of distributed transaction whitelists
IpHostPairNum.description_zh: 分布式事务白名单条目数

WhiteListGroups.description_zh: 分布式事务白名单分组列表

items.description_zh: 分布式事务白名单分组详情

SecurityIpHosts.description_en: The IP address of the ECS instance and the hostname of the Windows computer. Format: `IP address,Hostname`. Multiple values are separated with semicolons (;)
SecurityIpHosts.description_zh: ECS实例的IP地址和Windows系统的计算机名。格式：`ip,hostname`。多个实例之间以英文分号（;）隔开

WhitelistGroupName.description_en: The name of the distributed transaction whitelist
WhitelistGroupName.description_zh: 分布式事务白名单分组名称
